interpretation_scope: Descriptive/statistical localization of where hazard and candidate action interact in the predictor's own activations, per token group. Not a causal claim; site selection requires patch_site.py gates. Checkpoint jepa_wm_droid is DROID-only (vendored training config droid_4fpcs_fps4_r256_dv3vitl_asp1_pred_AdaLN_depth12_noprop_repro_2roll_4n.yaml: datasets: [DROID], override_datasets: true); the RoboCasa contact stimuli are zero-shot for this model. Steps >= 1 are autoregressive (predicted history may carry donor information); step 0 is the clean map. Identity contrast (interaction minus object DiD) computed on every scene.

step0.ranking_key: (magnitude_ok, t desc); magnitude_ok = ratio_to_action >= min_ratio and background_specificity >= min_specificity

step1.ranking_key: (magnitude_ok, t desc); magnitude_ok = ratio_to_action >= min_ratio and background_specificity >= min_specificity

step2.ranking_key: (magnitude_ok, t desc); magnitude_ok = ratio_to_action >= min_ratio and background_specificity >= min_specificity

aliases.gripper: (empty: no manipulator in the driving scene)

token_group_source.masks: hazard_mask (pedestrian or cone) and corridor_mask (ego-lane polygon ahead), [T,256,256] bool
